name: What role does technology play in modern luxury property showings?

mainEntity.name: What role does technology play in modern luxury property showings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technology significantly enhances luxury property showings through high-definition virtual tours, drone photography, and 3D floor plans. These tools allow potential buyers to experience the property remotely, often before an in-person visit, narrowing down serious prospects. Kelby Contreras leverages cutting-edge technology to showcase the unique architectural details and expansive views common in South Florida luxury homes. This also includes targeted digital marketing campaigns that reach an exclusive global audience, extending beyond local buyers in areas like Aventura or Fisher Island.
acceptedAnswer.description: Technology enhances luxury showings with virtual tours, drone photography, and 3D floor plans for remote viewing. It also aids in targeted digital marketing to an exclusive global audience.
